relationTypes.description: The first Issue establishes evidence or repository state the second Issue can use.
The Issue uses evidence or repository state established by its paired preparing relation.

issues.title: Receive and characterize the actual site source

acceptance.statement: The source origin, observed revision or date, and relationship to maintained source are recorded.
Runtime, package manager, lockfile, routes, assets, styles, fonts, manifests, and external-service boundaries are recorded from source.
A clean preview or build command succeeds, or the exact missing capability and its receiver are named.
Foundation collisions preserve both inputs and have a reviewed reconciliation route.

authority.statement: The collaborator may inspect accepted source and record bounded technology and behavior observations within the current grant.
The preparing owner selects and accepts the source coordinate that becomes maintained repository source.
Secret values stay in their authorized systems; repository intake records only declared names, observed dependencies, and exact owner actions.

nextReceiver.condition: The source coordinate and technology facts are accepted, and reproducibility or its exact blocker is recorded.

acceptance.statement: Root orientation and collaboration guidance agree with current source and the live Issue route.
The Concept Nursery, public and local reference lanes, and threadkeeping route each have a plain owner and receiving use.
A cold collaborator can identify the current front, typed relations, acceptance, held decisions, and next receiver from repository-held context.
One owner-readable continuation names the recovery coordinate, held decisions, and next owner action.

authority.statement: The collaborator may reconcile selected foundation modules and report collisions within the current Issue and task grant.
Repository identity, rights, visibility, transfer acceptance, publication, domains, and destructive recovery remain receiving-owner decisions.

nextReceiver.condition: The structural check passes, the live Issue route is legible, and the handoff names one exact owner decision or action.

relations.condition: Accepted source facts can select the fitting foundation reconciliation and checks.
Foundation reconciliation uses the accepted source coordinate, technology facts, and collision record.
